title: Ground Flick Control
description: Ask a partner to dribble slowly and practise flicking the sliotar away from a safe side angle.
target: Complete 10 controlled ground flicks from each side

title: Safe Hook Footwork
description: Practise chasing from behind and moving into a safe hook position without swinging hard.

title: Overhead Timing
description: With a qualified adult and plenty of space, practise timing controlled overhead contacts from gentle feeds.

title: Knock Down the Aliens
description: Set up safe cone targets and use an underarm throw to knock them down.

title: Beanbag Balance Journey
description: Balance a beanbag on the bas and walk through a safe course without dropping it.
